_comment: Golden frame vectors for the AAP link layer.
Both the Kotlin :protocol module and the Python emulator assert against
this file. The bytes were derived by hand from the written frame layout in
docs/01-aap-wire-format.md, not produced by running either implementation,
so the file is an independent third opinion rather than a snapshot of
whatever the code happened to do on the day it was written.
All byte strings are lowercase hex. 'flags' is the semantic flag value a
caller passes to the encoder (CONTROL=4, ENCRYPTED=8); the fragmentation
bits visible in 'frames' are derived by the encoder itself.

vectors.name: control message fits in one bulk frame
vectors.note: flags byte 0x07 = CONTROL|FIRST|LAST. No total-length field on a bulk frame.

vectors.name: encrypted payload on the video channel
empty payload still produces a well-formed frame
vectors.note: A zero-length message is legal; the header alone goes on the wire.

vectors.name: fragmented message with a short trailing fragment
vectors.note: Opening fragment carries the 8-byte header with total length 0x0000000a; continuations carry the 4-byte header only. The middle fragment has neither FIRST nor LAST, so its flags byte is 0x00.

vectors.name: payload that divides evenly into fragments
vectors.note: No empty trailing fragment when the payload is an exact multiple of the fragment size.

assemblyVectors.name: interleaved channels reassemble independently
_comment: Frames are fed to the assembler in the listed order. A fragmented
message on channel 3 is interrupted by a complete control message on
channel 0; the assembler must not splice them.

rejectVectors.name: continuation frame with no open message
rejectVectors.reason: LAST fragment on channel 3 without a preceding FIRST

rejectVectors.name: announced total length shorter than the first fragment
rejectVectors.reason: total length 2 is smaller than the 4-byte opening fragment

rejectVectors.name: message ends before its announced length
semantic flags change mid-message
rejectVectors.reason: opening fragment is ENCRYPTED, continuation is not
